map.液压马达选型工具基于扭矩-排量公式 V=2πT/(Δp·ηm)，输入所需扭矩、转: The hydraulic motor selection tool is based on the torque-displacement formula V=2πT/(Δp·ηm). Input required torque, speed and system pressure difference to compute motor displacement, required flow and output power, and recommend a motor type (gear/vane/piston/cycloidal) by pressure and speed. It applies to actuator selection in hydraulic circuits.
